label: Instrumental success versus categorical moral requirement
term: instrumental success versus categorical moral requirement
resolution: Realizes and OnlyEffective concern an outcome and a uniquely effective means within a stipulated one-step action profile, not a metaphysical causal mechanism. Their implication to performing that means is a structural fact about the profile, not an obligation to adopt the end or perform the means. GoalPractice.categoricalOught is a separate deontic parameter; two exact finite profiles agree on goals, actions and outcomes but disagree about duty. No robust action-theoretic or moral interpretation is derived by naming the profile an agency model.
